settings.text: Crafted from 100% pure cotton, this pajama set delivers a smooth, lightweight feel that’s gentle on your skin. Its breathable, hypoallergenic fabric keeps you cool and comfortable all night long while the soft texture adds a touch of everyday luxury, perfect for relaxing evenings and restful summer nights.

This cotton pajama set combines timeless charm with everyday ease, featuring a soft-touch fabric in a relaxed fit that drapes naturally against the skin. The classic polka-dot pattern adds a playful, elegant detail, while the lightweight structure and elastic waistband ensure full freedom of movement. A perfect blend of style and comfort for slow mornings and restful nights.

I bought this pajama set for a summer trip, and I’ve barely taken it off since. The muslin cotton is unbelievably soft and airy. It feels like sleeping in a cloud. I’ll definitely be ordering another color!
